issue.title: Notify where each new reading task landed after a Mac highlights scan, via reading-task fields in ref scan JSON

task_type_fields.proposal: After the Mac's scheduled `bob highlights scan`, tell Bryan where each new reading task landed ("📖 Reading task created in sase · The Essay Title"), so a research report or captured link visibly arrives in its parent note. Enabler: `bob ref scan -f json` reports nothing about reading-task writes today. The human report prints `📖 N reading tasks created · sase.md (1)`, but `src/native/highlights_ref/scan_json.rs` (envelope from bob-cli-5x, built in parallel with bob-cli-5y) has no reading-task fields, and docs/highlights-ref-sync.md says "JSON output is unchanged". An additive per-note `reading_task: {action: created|updated|adopted, path, block_id}` plus `summary.reading_tasks_created/updated` (schema stays 1) would let Bob Mac Capture's Refs scan lane (Just scanned section, hidden-panel notifications) show it as a thin client. Proposed in plan:202610/ref_tasks_live_with_parent.md closeout step 5 ("a 'reading task created in sase' notification after the Mac scan").
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-5y's scope ended at writing the task into the parent note; a notification is new UX across bob-cli JSON and Bob Mac Capture's scan lane, and the bob-cli-5y.7/bob-cli-62 landing deliberately kept the scan JSON unchanged.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-5y's plan listed a post-scan reading-task notification as a closeout follow-up; its closeout phase never recorded it.
